notes: The kept set covers Hox and body-plan evolution (teleost caudal fin), vertebrate neural-crest origins, morphological novelty and co-option (Drosophila genitalia, nematode predatory mouth, liverwort setae), evolution of developmental bias and of gastrulation mechanics, cis-regulatory evolution (mammalian enhancer innovation, convergent hibernation elements, conserved cucurbit fruit CREs), WGD consequences (yeast multicellularity experiment, angiosperm homoeolog dosage), paralog retention, de novo gene evolution and yeast gene-family gain and loss. It lacks non-bilaterian and deep body-plan work, sex-determination and supergene loci, and animal comparative-genome papers; several further fitting papers (pmid:37714829, pmid:40542495, pmid:36477354, pmid:40244654, pmid:36625090, pmid:39136558, pmid:40967205, pmid:38039969) were cut only by the cap of 15.
